rfm_tuples.R: 10-K Note 7: 'On October 1, 2025, we completed the acquisition of Iodine Software Holdings, Inc. for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $1,259.8 million. The consideration paid was approximately $638.9 million in cash consideration and 16,639,920 shares of common stock having a value of $37.31 per share.' Filed as transformative AI clinical-intelligence acquisition.
rfm_tuples.f: Mode A — verify purchase price allocation and confirm CAM disclosure. Mode B — assess goodwill loading vs. tangible assets and the share-consideration valuation timing.
rfm_tuples.M_value: Iodine total consideration $1,259.8M = $638.9M cash + 16.64M WAY shares valued at $37.31 each. Allocated $290.6M to customer relationship intangible; balance to goodwill ($996.8M increment) and other intangibles. KPMG designated the customer-relationship intangible as a CRITICAL AUDIT MATTER explicitly because 'subjective auditor judgment was required to evaluate the revenue forecast.' Total goodwill at 12/31/25 = $4,016.8M; total assets $5,785.1M — goodwill alone = 69.4% of total assets; goodwill + intangibles combined = 91.7% of total assets (vs. prior 87% pre-Iodine). The 16.64M WAY shares issued were valued at $37.31 = 63% above the cutoff price; at cutoff the stock-consideration component is worth ~$381M vs. the $620M originally accounted, implying ~$240M of equity dilution at no-longer-recoverable value to existing holders. WAY contributed $31.0M of revenue in Q4 (Oct-Dec) and $1.4M loss on Iodine; full-year run-rate ~$120-130M revenue per the disclosures.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Mode B catch — the Iodine deal was struck at a top-tick WAY share price ($37.31, well above current $23 cutoff) and loaded $1.0B of net goodwill onto a balance sheet that is now 91.7% intangible. KPMG's CAM language flags the revenue-forecast subjectivity. If Iodine revenue underperforms by 15-20%, a 2026 or 2027 quantitative goodwill test could force material impairment. Disclosure is technically complete but the goodwill cushion is not quantified.

Q1 2026: revenue $313.9M vs. $256.4M Q1'25 = +22.4%; Iodine quarterly run-rate ~$30M (Q4'25 was $31.0M for ~91 days post-close); implied Q1'26 ex-Iodine ~$284M vs. $256.4M = +10.7% organic. So organic growth has decelerated from ~17% (Q1'25 baseline implied by FY24 trends) to ~13.2% (FY25) to ~10.7% (Q1'26). Subscription revenue $558.4M (50.8% of total) vs. volume-based; growth concentrated in clients spending >$100K (1,391 vs. 1,203, +15.6%). NRR 112% — still strong but slipping (114% in 2024 per peer disclosures).
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Mode B catch — the 16.5% headline number is meaningfully boosted by 3 months of Iodine. Organic deceleration from low-teens to ~10-11% in Q1'26 is consistent with the Change Healthcare cyberattack tailwind (Feb 2024, drove 30,000 new clients) now fully lapped. This is the kind of growth slowdown that a 60x P/E (pre-drawdown) cannot absorb, and explains the -52.5% multiple compression.

Q1'26: total debt $1,477.7M ($1,377.7M first lien after $20M paydown on 2026-02-23 + $100M receivables expanded), cash $34.3M + investments $124.6M = $158.9M, net debt ~$1.32B vs. Adj EBITDA run-rate ~$540M (Q1 margin 43.1% × annualized $1.26B) = ~2.4x. But the equity component of Iodine consideration and the February 2026 receivables-facility expansion both signal the balance sheet is tight enough that management is actively managing it through a low stock-price environment. Not a SEVERE distress signal but inconsistent with a 'capital-strength' narrative.

summary: WAY is a -52.5% drawdown post-IPO healthcare-IT name where the FORENSIC tape is bifurcated. NEGATIVE: sponsors (EQT/Bain/CPP) cashed out $2.16B across three secondaries at $37-39 (60-70% above cutoff) in the 14 months Feb-Sep 2025; CEO Hawkins sold $25.2M (all 10b5-1, with a fresh 600K-share plan adopted 2025-12-04); CBO Sinclair resigned 2026-02-02 (effective 2026-03-02) with no successor named at cutoff; organic revenue growth decelerated from ~13% (FY25) to ~11% (Q1'26) as the Change Healthcare cyberattack tailwind laps; Iodine acquisition closed at top-tick share price ($37.31 stock consideration now worth $23) and loaded $1.0B of net goodwill onto a balance sheet that is now 91.7% intangible; ~$2.6B of unsold sponsor stock remains as supply overhang. POSITIVE: Director Heidi Miller bought 7,200 shares at $26.25 on 2026-03-02 — a true open-market discretionary purchase (no 10b5-1 footnote, 13 days post-10-K) into the drawdown — but sized at only $189K vs. $25M+ CEO sales. KPMG clean opinion since 2021, no going concern, no material weakness, no restatement. Revenue +16.5% to $1.099B, GAAP profitable for first time ($112M vs -$19M), Adj EBITDA margin 42%, NRR 112%. The accounting floor prevents fraud-tier escalation, but the sponsor-overhang + tailwind-lapping + 'CBO out the door' tape is consistent with continued price weakness. Severity: 2 PASS / 0 UNVERIFIABLE / 6 MODERATE / 2 SEVERE / 0 RED_FLAG. Verdict: SHORT-tier. The Heidi Miller buy is the lone bullish data point and is too small to swing the composite.
